brief:
Israeli forces have displaced 537 families in Hebron during a military operation now in its tenth day, Palestine News Network reported. A support and relief committee appointed by Hebron Governor Khaled Dudin has been conducting round-the-clock operations to assist displaced residents and address their immediate needs.

The operation has caused millions of dollars in economic losses to the city, according to the report. The relief committee continues efforts to provide aid to families forced from their homes.

title: Israeli military operation displaces 537 families in Hebron
